projects.title: Envoy Studio (CreatorsAGI)
projects.description:
Platform for deploying configurable AI agents on clients' own domains. 
 
 Architected the multi-tenant foundation — per-tenant auth and onboarding with WorkOS AuthKit, tenant isolation, and dynamic subdomain and custom-domain routing in Next.js — plus a reusable component SDK teams use to compose client-specific experiences. At the core is a generative-UI system: structured AI outputs become modular React components, streamed live to client sites over SSE. Also built the Stripe subscription and usage-based credit system behind it, and cut LCP by ~97% across 25+ pages.

projects.title: FormKiQ
projects.description:
AWS-partnered document platform handling 50M+ documents. 
 
 Built the front end in React, TypeScript, Redux and Tailwind — archive creation, user activity views, and an interactive drag-and-drop workflow builder using React Flow.

projects.title: Conscious
projects.description:
Chrome extension for mindful shopping. 
 
 A gentle prompt appears while you shop on Amazon, asking whether the purchase is really necessary, and a private dashboard tracks what you saved by walking away. Shopping data never leaves the browser. Landing page built with Next.js.

projects.title: Royal Path
projects.description:
React Native game with swipe mechanics, shipped to the Play Store. 
 
 Built end to end — gesture-based swipe interactions, animation and local state. As a monarch, navigate advisors, villagers, allies and foes, and shape your kingdom's destiny.
